title: ericameria parryi var. affinis
intro: Ericameria parryi var. affinis, commonly known as Parry's goldenrod, is a perennial plant that belongs to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is known for its medicinal properties, which have been utilized to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and pain. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which are thought to be due to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Parry's goldenrod have been shown to have potential therapeutic applications, making it a valuable plant for further research and development.
